name: Transfix

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or is Charmed and Incapacitated, and on its turns it moves straight toward you, provoking Opportunity Attacks as usual. If it ends a turn within 5 feet of you it takes 4d8 Psychic damage (+1d8 per slot level above 7). Later, a Magic action lets you target another creature with it; a creature that saved against this casting can't be targeted again. (The book also has it save again before walking into a harmful area; the game doesn't stop it.)
